Export from your old phone or a computer, copy the file to this phone, then import it here. Parley reads the file on this phone; nothing is downloaded or sent.
Bring your contacts, calls or block list along. You can also do this later from Tools.
From another phone with Parley
Restore a backup
Restore a Parley backup

On the old phone: Tools › Encrypted backups › Back up now, or Move to a new phone. Copy the backup to this phone, then choose Restore from a file… and enter its passphrase. It brings private contacts, notes, Situations and your settings too.
Restore before you set things up: a restore puts back the old phone\'s settings.
From another phone with Parley? Restore a backup

Import contacts
Import call history
Import a block list
Google Contacts
On the old phone, open Google\'s Contacts app › Fix & manage › Export to file. Or, on a computer, open contacts.google.com › Export › vCard. Copy the .vcf file to this phone, then import it.
Signed in to the same Google account on this phone? Those contacts are already here, so there\'s nothing to import.
iPhone or iCloud

On the iPhone (iOS 16 or later): Contacts › Lists, touch and hold All Contacts › Export. Or, on a computer, open iCloud.com › Contacts, select all, then Export vCard. Copy the .vcf file to this phone (by email to yourself, a cable or a cloud folder), then import it.
Samsung phone
In Samsung\'s Contacts app, open the menu › Manage contacts › Import or export contacts › Export, and save to the phone\'s storage. Copy the .vcf file to this phone, then import it.
Call history from a CSV file
Export your calls as a CSV file on the old phone, for example with a call-log backup app or Logger. Copy it to this phone and import it: Parley shows what it will add before anything is saved.
Call Blocker
In Call Blocker, back up or export your list: a .cbbk backup (you\'ll need its password) or a JSON file. Copy it to this phone, then choose Import from Call Blocker.
Yet Another Call Blocker
In Yet Another Call Blocker, open the blacklist and export it as a CSV file. Copy it to this phone, choose Yet Another Call Blocker blacklist, then pick the file.
NoPhoneSpam
Save NoPhoneSpam\'s list as a plain text file, one number or pattern per line. Copy it to this phone, choose NoPhoneSpam list, then pick the file.
Private contacts are kept only in Parley, encrypted and hidden from other apps. Their name still shows when they call.
Temporary contacts delete themselves when their time is up. You can keep any of them permanently.
Your Circle is the people you want to keep in touch with, each with a gentle rhythm. Unlike Favourites, it doesn\'t star anyone, and it stays empty until you add someone.
Labels are groups you make yourself, like Family or Work: filter by them, message everyone in one, or give one a ringtone.
Favourites are your starred contacts, one tap away; other apps see the star too. Frequent, under them, is who you call most, picked from your calls.
History & undo is where to get things back: contacts and calls deleted or changed in Parley for 30 days, and daily snapshots.
